title: He rested an innocent book on the edge of the desk, smiling his defiance
html_source:
There’s a juxtaposition between innocent and defiance indicating Best’s mute personality and his contradiction of Eglinton’s statement in the previous paragraph

Stephen must negotiate this:

Eglinton’s nebulous depiction of Shakespeare’s life and Best’s factual statements that Hamlet is autobiographical.
